card.name: Drug development and FDA regulation text
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces, or digits inside text about FDA, drug approval, clinical trials, or drug safety review, where a word like drug, testing or safety may come next. Also the digits in the FDA phone number 1-800-FDA-1088.
